description:
Alay is an Indonesian subculture that gained prevalence in the mid-2000s to early 2010s, related to a pop culture phenomenon often describing an excessive, tacky (norak) version of Harajuku , Emo , and Jejemon . It is characterized by hyper-expressive, flashy behaviors, overly maximalist aesthetics, and text. The word is a mixture of anak lebay (excessive/hyperbolic) or anak layangan (kite child).

It features dramatic posing for social media, expressive selfies, attitude and uses scrambled alternating capitalization of letters (MiXeD cApS) and numbers blended with letters (like h4l0 instead of Halo).
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Self-Expression
